Locked-off camera, framing holds. The masked man takes two slow steps along the line toward the lens, head nodding on a steady beat. His right gloved hand chops down on each beat, four times; his left hand counts off fingers, then both hands stop at chest height. The waiting workers stand still, holding their cards. Mask, hat, suit and gloves stay unchanged; no new objects appear. SFX: shoes on wooden boards, a ticking punch clock. Ambient noise: quiet factory hum.

Thanks.
